title: Improving the Activity of Trp-Rich Antimicrobial Peptides by Arg/Lys Substitutions and Changing the Length of Cationic Residues
adjudication_summary: Source re-review recovered all primary Table 2 MIC rows, reconciled DBAASP assay records against the local table, preserved one hArg MIC source conflict plus database-only entry-text cautions, and closed the prior framework-test rework ticket without fabricating unsupported toxicity or figure-derived values.
summary: Worker-2/4/6 source re-review recovered the paper-local activity matrix and completed final adjudication with nonblocking cautions.

materials_exhausted.note: No supplementary assets were present locally; owner-layer blockers were recoverable from XML/PDF/OA package/database snapshots.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay rows were crosswalked to XML Table 2 and article metadata; one hArg MIC mismatch is preserved as source_conflict, while CAMP/dbAMP entry-text rows remain database_only_no_primary_source.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: All 20 XML/PDF Table 2 MIC rows were recovered with target, unit, sequence, method, replicate/range context, and locators. No primary-source toxicity rows are fabricated from database-only entries.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism evidence is bounded to direct membrane permeabilization/leakage assays plus structure/stability context; figure curves are not converted into exact activity values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The prior rework target is resolved because source review and gates now operate on source-backed activity/database/mechanism artifacts rather than framework placeholders.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP source_id DBAASPS_7826 is named as the hArg Tritrp analog but carries MIC 2-4 µM, while XML Table 2 reports Tritrp-hArg MIC 4 µM. The row remains source_conflict and is not smoothed into source_verified.

CAMP/dbAMP entry-level records contain additional organism/cell/toxicity annotations not present as primary assay rows in this paper; they are preserved as database_only_no_primary_source and not promoted into final activity/toxicity rows.
Packet/source inventory contains no supplementary files or supplementary tables; XML/PDF/OA package figures and database snapshots were sufficient for the owner-layer repair.
Mechanism figures are retained qualitatively with source locators; exact plotted curve values are not converted into tabular activity rows.
